evals.prompt: My Compose app's buttons feel dead when tapped. Add proper press feedback to the primary buttons on the checkout screen (they're regular Button composables in CheckoutScreen.kt). Don't change any business logic.
evals.expected_output: Adds press-scale modifier (0.97, spring crisp retarget, graphicsLayer draw-phase read, retains ripple) wired through interactionSource, no hardcoded durations — uses MotionTokens; if no tokens file exists, creates MotionTokens.kt from assets template; does not remove ripple or change onClick logic.

evals.prompt: The list screen in my news app opens a detail page and it just pops in instantly. Everything is Jetpack Compose with navigation-compose. Make navigation feel premium — the list items are cards with a hero image. Also the first time the list appears it should not feel like everything dumps on screen at once.
evals.expected_output: Plan with one hero: shared-element image morph card-to-detail (SharedTransitionLayout + sharedElement with stable id keys, Hero 500ms Emphasized) or slide+fade fallback with correct durations; pop transitions mirrored; list first-load stagger 18ms capped at 350ms gated so it doesn't replay on back navigation; exits faster than enters; RTL-aware offsets; MotionTokens used throughout.

evals.prompt: Add a like button (heart icon) to my feed rows. When tapped it should feel really satisfying, and it should handle people spam-tapping it. Compose, of course.
evals.expected_output: Anticipation dip + playful single-bounce spring via Animatable in LaunchedEffect keyed on liked state (cancel semantics handle spam), accent color crossfade, haptic on landing (LocalHapticFeedback / CONFIRM), no bounce on any other element, icon scale via graphicsLayer lambda, contentDescription stays correct.

evals.prompt: QA flagged that when users turn on 'Remove animations' in developer options, our onboarding flow breaks — the next button stops working until the animation would have finished. It's all Compose. Fix it and make sure this can't happen again anywhere.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that Compose animations ignore ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE, wires LocalReducedMotion/MotionSettingsProvider (reads Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE), replaces blocking onAnimationEnd-style logic with state-driven content so final states render instantly, applies motionSpec helper; also notes Views respect the scale automatically; adds reduced-motion checks to the review flow.
